name: Big Mistakes
description: Blackmailed into working for some very dangerous people, two deeply incapable siblings become the most disorganized duo in organized crime.

videos.title: Get Your Nonna a Necklace
videos.overview: Tasked with buying a sentimental gift for their dying grandmother, bickering siblings Nicky and Morgan commit a minor crime with major consequences.

videos.title: I Will Do ANYTHING to Survive
videos.overview: A dangerous ultimatum from Yusuf forces Morgan and Nicky to run interference at an already chaotic family funeral.

videos.title: Show Me the Money
videos.overview: Nicky and Morgan's success is short-lived when they're coerced into a "friendship" with Yusuf's boss. Linda reconsiders her run for mayor.

videos.title: Weakness Always Exposes Itself
videos.overview: Nicky and Tareq share their feelings, while Morgan and Max get personal at couple's therapy. A surprise guest adds extra spice to a family dinner.

videos.title: James 4:17
videos.overview: When a job at a cattle auction goes sideways, Nicky must leverage his job to prove his worth. Linda's campaign gets a boost from a political scandal.

videos.title: You F-ck with My Family, You F-ck with Me
videos.overview: A fed-up Nicky tries to cut ties with Ivan — and his sister — as he prepares to come clean about Tareq. Morgan attends an uncomfortable baby shower.

videos.title: I've Really Enjoyed My Time with You
videos.overview: Anxious to impress an important partner, Ivan splashes out on a trip to Miami. Nicky and Morgan connect on a new level after a stimulating dinner.

videos.title: Rock, Paper, Scissors
videos.overview: Morgan and Nicky brace for blowback from the Miami operation as their family, friends and some unwelcome faces converge around the election results.
